outcome: Pain during IUD insertion (measured on a 0-100 mm visual analog scale)
cohort: 98 first-time IUD users (CuT380A or levonorgestrel IUS)
finding: Women with a history of vaginal delivery experienced significantly less pain during IUD insertion compared to women without a history of vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: History of vaginal delivery was associated with a 15.5 point reduction in pain during IUD insertion.
